title: Evaluation of the Effectiveness of the Parkinson Specialized Teams Intervention
official: Evaluation of the Effectiveness of the Parkinson's Specialized Teams Intervention on the Quality of Life of Parkinson's Patients in the Territory of the Nouvelle-Aquitaine and Hauts-de-France: ES-Park Pilot Study.
summary: A pilot experiment interventional study is proposed in order to set up multidisciplinary team for Parkinson's patients at home. The aim of this study is to evaluate the effectiveness of this specialized Parkinson's team (ESPark) intervention a on the quality of life of patients with moderate to severe Parkinson's disease
